question: What's new on Raymond James in the last 90 days?

claims.text: Raymond James Financial: On 2026-11-12, trade press reports Raymond James will add $18.7 billion and 70 advisors to its Financial Institutions Division, the unit dedicated to bank and credit union advisors, as an existing FID program merges with Synovus Financial Corp.; the deal expands Pinnacle Financial Partners' relationship with Raymond James. Why it might matter: the advisors are expected to transition in May 2027, a forward-looking timeline for a client-asset addition to the FID unit.
